'use client' import { BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, SkeletonText, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { ChartPanelTable } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/chart-panel' import { FlowChart, type FlowLink, type FlowNode, getFlowColumns, getFlowTotals, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/flow' import { KPIValue } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface Flow2Props { description: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ links?: FlowLink[] nodes?: FlowNode[] status?: BlockStatus title: string /** @default 'visitors' */ unit?: string } const exampleProps: Flow2Props = { description: 'Where visitors go in their first three pages after landing on Home, last 7 days. Grey bands are visitors who left.', links: [ { source: 'home', target: 'pricing-2', value: 4_820 }, { source: 'home', target: 'features-2', value: 3_640 }, { source: 'home', target: 'docs-2', value: 2_210 }, { source: 'home', target: 'exit-2', value: 5_330 }, { source: 'pricing-2', target: 'signup-3', value: 1_540 }, { source: 'pricing-2', target: 'sales-3', value: 610 }, { source: 'pricing-2', target: 'docs-3', value: 720 }, { source: 'pricing-2', target: 'exit-3', value: 1_950 }, { source: 'features-2', target: 'pricing-3', value: 1_380 }, { source: 'features-2', target: 'signup-3', value: 520 }, { source: 'features-2', target: 'exit-3', value: 1_740 }, { source: 'docs-2', target: 'signup-3', value: 290 }, { source: 'docs-2', target: 'docs-3', value: 1_120 }, { source: 'docs-2', target: 'exit-3', value: 800 }, ], nodes: [ { id: 'home', label: 'Home' }, { id: 'pricing-2', label: 'Pricing' }, { id: 'features-2', label: 'Features' }, { id: 'docs-2', label: 'Docs' }, { id: 'exit-2', kind: 'exit', label: 'Left' }, { id: 'signup-3', label: 'Sign up' }, { id: 'sales-3', label: 'Contact sales' }, { id: 'pricing-3', label: 'Pricing' }, { id: 'docs-3', label: 'Docs' }, { id: 'exit-3', kind: 'exit', label: 'Left' }, ], title: 'User paths', unit: 'visitors', } const Flow2 = (props: Flow2Props) => { const { description, links = [], nodes = [], status, title, unit = 'visitors' } = props const state = getBlockState(status, links) const totals = getFlowTotals(nodes, links) const labels = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node.label])) const start = nodes.find((node) => (totals.get(node.id)?.in ?? 0) === 0) const entered = start ? (totals.get(start.id)?.out ?? 0) : 0 const columnOf = getFlowColumns(nodes, links) const columns = Math.max(0, ...columnOf.values()) const leftAt = Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => nodes .filter((node) => node.kind === 'exit' && columnOf.get(node.id) === index + 1) .reduce((sum, node) => sum + (totals.get(node.id)?.in ?? 0), 0), ) const percent = (value: number) => formatPercent(value / (entered || 1), { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) return (
